description: U.S. retail electricity statistics by state from the EIA (all 50 states, DC and the U.S. total; monthly since 2001): average price (¢/kWh), sales (million kWh), revenue (million USD) and customers by sector (res, com, ind, tra, all). Default: Texas and the U.S. residential price. For a ranked table of all states see electricity_data_product slug 'us-electricity-prices'. Monthly series: the free window is the latest month. Free (no key or free key): the most recent 30 days of each series; a Pro key unlocks full history. Values are exact as published with unit, date and original source URL; incomplete days are flagged, never filled. Free for non-commercial use with attribution; commercial use requires Pro.

measure.description: price (default), sales, revenue, customers — comma-separated, or all

sector.description: res (default), com, ind, tra, all — comma-separated

start.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ending at the series' latest date. Older dates need a Pro key.

state.description: Two-letter code(s), comma-separated (TX, CA, DC …; US = U.S. total), or all. Default TX,US

name: market_us_states
